job.title: Team Leader - Public Gardens
job.description:
Team Leader - Public Gardens | Horticulture|Tanawha, Sunshine Coast  

Lead a small crew. Work outdoors. Enjoy consistent hours and great pay!

We are seeking an experienced Team Leader - Public Gardens to lead a small crew undertaking commercial garden maintenance and upkeep of public spaces across the Sunshine Coast.
This is a hands-on leadership role suited to someone with a strong background in commercial gardening, horticulture or landscaping who can confidently coordinate a small team, lead by example and deliver quality outcomes.

What's on Offer?
  • Consistent working hours: 6:30am - 3:30pm.
  • TOIL arrangements where required.
  • Safety and performance incentives.
  • Uniform, PPE and phone allowance.
  • Training and career progression opportunities.
  • Christmas week off.
Please note: No company vehicle is provided.

About the Role

You'll lead a small field crew of 2-3 people, coordinating daily activities and ensuring public gardens, parks and landscaped areas are maintained to a high standard.
Working under the guidance of the Regional Foreman, you'll be responsible for daily work allocation, team performance, safety and the delivery of scheduled maintenance activities.

Your responsibilities will include:
  • Leading and coordinating a small field crew to achieve daily work targets.
  • Undertaking hands-on gardening, landscaping and grounds maintenance.
  • Allocating daily tasks and monitoring work quality and productivity.
  • Training and mentoring new team members.
  • Operating and maintaining commercial gardening equipment, including hedgers, pruners, brush cutters and edge trimmers.
  • Completing equipment inspections and reporting faults.
  • Coordinating seasonal maintenance activities, including mulching, reduction pruning and herbicide application.
  • Completing digital job reporting, forms and client documentation using a smartphone or tablet.
  • Troubleshooting day-to-day site issues and escalating where required.
  • Ensuring all work is completed safely and in accordance with relevant procedures.
  • Maintaining professional relationships with supervisors, team members and the public.
Skills & Experience

  • Certificate III in Horticulture, Parks and Gardens, Landscaping or equivalent.
  • Minimum 2 years' commercial gardening, landscaping or parks maintenance experience.
  • At least 1 year of experience leading or supervising a small team.
  • Construction White Card.
  • Open driver's licence (no interlock).
  • Experience safely operating and maintaining commercial gardening machinery with minimal supervision.
  • Basic knowledge of local weed identification.
  • Confidence using smartphones and tablets for digital reporting and job management.
  • Full Australian working rights.
  • Physical fitness to undertake outdoor manual work, including lifting up to 20kg and walking up to 10km per day.
Highly regarded qualifications:
  • MR Truck Licence.
  • First Aid and CPR.
  • ACDC Chemical Spraying Licence.
  • TMI / Traffic Management qualification.
The Ideal Candidate
  • Takes pride in the quality of their work.
  • Can confidently lead, motivate and support a small crew.
  • Has strong communication and organisational skills.
  • Can manage daily workloads and work independently.
  • Has a proactive approach to safety and problem-solving.
  • Enjoys working outdoors and maintaining public spaces.

Submit your resume today, outlining your commercial gardening experience, qualifications and previous team leadership experience.
Please note this is a Drug and Alcohol Free Workplace, with employees subject to pre-employment and ongoing drug and alcohol testing in accordance with workplace policy.

job.title: Senior Project Manager
job.description:
We are partnering with a leading Darwin-based construction company, delivering high-quality commercial construction across the Northern Territory.

With a strong reputation for quality, safety and local engagement, they continue to invest in their people, projects and the communities in which they operate.

With major projects secured through to 2028 and a strong pipeline of future work beyond that, this is an outstanding opportunity to join a business offering long-term stability, career growth and the chance to play a key role in shaping project outcomes across the NT.
 
Due to continued growth, they are seeking an experienced Senior Project Manager to be based full time in Darwin and take ownership of projects from tender stage through to successful delivery and close-out.
 
The Role

This is a senior leadership position responsible for overseeing the full project lifecycle, combining commercial, contractual and operational responsibilities. You will work closely with clients, subcontractors and internal stakeholders to ensure projects are delivered safely, on schedule and within budget while maintaining strong commercial outcomes.
 
Key Responsibilities
  • Lead projects from estimating and tendering through to delivery and final handover.
  • Prepare and review tender submissions, pricing, cost plans and project budgets.
  • Develop and manage scopes of work, subcontract packages and procurement activities.
  • Oversee contract administration, variations, claims and project reporting.
  • Manage project programmes, forecasting, cash flow and commercial performance.
  • Identify and manage project risks, opportunities and commercial exposures.
  • Lead and mentor project teams to drive performance, accountability and successful project outcomes.
  • Support ongoing business growth through client engagement and project acquisition activities.
About You
  • Proven experience in a Senior Project Manager or Project Manager role.
  • Strong background in commercial construction.
  • Demonstrated experience across estimating, tendering, contract administration and project delivery.
  • Strong commercial acumen with the ability to manage budgets, margins and project performance.
  • Experience developing scopes of work, procurement strategies and subcontractor agreements.
  • Ability to lead projects through the full lifecycle from pre-contract through to completion.
  • Willing to fully relocate to Darwin.
What's on Offer
  • Senior leadership role based in Darwin.
  • Diverse and challenging project portfolio.
  • Long-term project pipeline with secured work through to 2028 and beyond.
  • High level of autonomy and influence across project delivery.
  • Strong company culture with a focus on quality, safety and continuous improvement.
  • Competitive salary package and relocation assistance available for the right candidate.
If you're a commercially focused project leader looking for a role where you can genuinely influence outcomes, build strong client relationships and lead projects from tender to completion, please call Kieran on 0420 727 200
